_comment: wintty.c erase_menu_or_text() repairs a corner menu with docorner(offx, maxrow + 1, 0), whose cl_end() starts at column offx - 1. In wizard-mode ^T, getpos.c reports an absent fountain with "Can't find dungeon feature '{'."; picking the hero's own square then teleports onto a pile, and look_here()'s menu opens beside that acknowledged message without clearing it. Dismissing the menu erases the message's final period, which no later flush restores. Seed, date, Samurai and inputs chosen independently.
